name: Heritage of Mercury. Almadén and Idrija
description: This pair of towns, Almadén in Spain's Castile-La Mancha and Idrija in Slovenia, hosted the world's two largest mercury mines. Almadén's mining goes back to antiquity, while Idrija's began after a find in 1490. Mercury from both helped extract gold and silver from American ores. Visitors can go underground in Almadén's Mining Park, see Retamar Castle and an old bullring made of miners' homes, or explore Idrija's mercury stores and miners' theatre.
